Getting started

What is Sheikh Zayed Housing programme(SZHP)?

The Sheikh Zayed Housing Program is a government initiative aimed at providing affordable housing solutions to eligible customers.

Who is eligible for a home loan under this programme?

The programme is exclusive for UAE Nationals as per the list that SZHP provides to Emirates NBD.

What are the benefits of obtaining a home loan through Emirates NBD under this programme?

Emirates NBD offers interest free for maximum finance amount of  800,000 and competitive interest rates flexible repayment options and personalized assistance throughout the loan process.

Do I have to transfer my salary to Emirates NBD to apply?

No, a salary transfer is not mandatory. However, you are encouraged to transfer your salary to Emirates NBD if you intend to avail other benefits, we offer to the UAE national segment.

What loan finance is available?

The maximum home finance amount available is  800,000 (interest free - at an interest rate subsidized by SZHP). If you require an additional finance amount, subject to your eligibility, the financing will be provided based on a special competitive commercial rate.

What is the loan tenor available for home loan under this programme?

The maximum finance tenor is 25 years.

At what rate is the financing provided?

The financing of the  800,000 amount is interest free for the customer. Any additional amount required will be given back on your eligibility and on a special competitive commercial rate.

What type of properties can be financed under this programme?

Financing is provided for both self-construction and ready property projects as follows:

  • Ready property finance – developed by SZHP
  • Ready property finance – developer or secondary market in the UAE
  • Self-construction finance – on own or gifted plot
What payments and additional fees I need to make on the finance property?
  • In case of ready property purchase, you will pay a down payment of minimum of 15% of the additional finance value take over and above the grant amount of  800,000.
  • There is no processing fees.
  • Valuation fees are  6000 for self-construction and  3,000 for ready property, including VAT.
Can I apply for home loan insurance through Emirates NBD?

Yes, we offer home loan insurance options to protect your investment. Property insurance is complementary and life insurance is optional. Our team can provide details on available policies.

Can I apply for home loan insurance through Emirates NBD?

Yes, we offer home loan insurance options to protect your investment. Property insurance is complementary and life insurance is optional. Our team can provide details on available policies.

Can I make partial or early repayments on my Home loan without penalties?

Yes, SZHP home loan product allows for partial or early repayments without penalties. Please check the loan agreement for specific terms.

What happens if I miss an EMI payment?

Missing EMI payments may result in penalties or affect your credit score. It is essential to communicate with our bank if you encounter financial difficulties.

How can I apply for a home loan under the Sheikh Zayed Housing Program through Emirates NBD?

You may call our call center at 600 54 0000 or visit the nearest Branch located in your area. We encourage you to submit you query through the application form available in our website.

How does the application process work?

The process involves document verification, credit assessment, property appraisal/evaluation, and final approval. Our team will assist you at every step.

How can I check the status of my home loan application?

You may reach out to your mortgage advisor as well as you will be notified through SMS/Email about the status of your application through the whole process.

What documents do I need to submit when applying for a home loan?

Refer to the customer document requirements in the webpage

How long does it take for home loan to get approved?

7 to 10 working days provided that you provide all the documents required

Can I transfer my existing home loan from another bank to Emirates NBD?

For free hold it is permissible. However, for granted land, it is subject to the relevant authorities’ approvals.

What happens in case of changes in interest rates during my home loan tenure?

The margin on the loan remains unchanged. However, the variable component (EIBOR) change based on the prevailing market rate. This only apply to the over and above  800,000 finance amount.
